Founded as '''I. ČSŠK Bratislava''' in 1919, the club adopted its current name in 1953. Slovan is the most successful football club in Slovakia, having won the most league and cup titles in the country. Slovan Bratislava became the first, and so far only, club from Slovakia and the former [[Czechoslovakia]] to win a European club competition, winning the [[1968–69 European Cup Winners' Cup|European Cup Winners' Cup]] by defeating [[FC Barcelona|Barcelona]] in the final in [[Basel]] in 1969. The club also supplied seven players to the Czechoslovakia national team that won [[UEFA Euro 1976]]."}}
